subject: Salesforce co-sell: evidence packet and next steps for marketplace listing
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@salesforce.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: salesforce-procurement@salesforce.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood co-sell listing — security evidence request

Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — procurement/security here needs a compact bundle of artifacts so we can move the co-sell marketplace listing forward. Specifically Salesforce security has asked for: 1) current SOC 2 Type II report, 2) a recent penetration-test attestation or letter, 3) an executed DPA that maps to partner requirements, and 4) a short inventory sheet (CSV) listing the documents and who to contact for follow-up.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide these items by end of next week (EOD Aug 28)? If there are any IP/redaction concerns we can accept redacted reports with a signed attestation.

Attn: Ben Carter (acme-retail) is on the thread as the pilot customer; he may surface additional compliance questions.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Partner Security Program Manager | Salesforce

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@salesforce.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood co-sell listing — security evidence request

Aisha —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II (2024) and a DPA executed for Salesforce by early next week. The pen-test attestation is finalizing — our security partner completed a scope-limited assessment in Q1 2025 and we have an attestation letter; I'll confirm whether we can circulate the full report or provide a signed attestation only.

I'm looping in Sergio (security) for attestation and Laura (legal/compliance) for the DPA. Marcus will prepare the evidence-index CSV.

Proposed timeline: SOC2 + DPA by Mon Aug 24, PenTest attestation + index by Wed Aug 26. If that works for procurement we’ll attach redacted pages where needed.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0134

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@salesforce.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood co-sell listing — security evidence request

Aisha / Vanessa —

Attaching the pen-test attestation (PDF stub referenced below) — this is an executive attestation signed by our 3rd-party assessor confirming scope and findings; the raw vulnerability report is restricted but we can provide redacted excerpts if Salesforce requires specifics for validation.

Attachment: PenTest_Attestation_2025.pdf (attestation letter, 1 page)

Also attaching the SOC2 Type II report (redacted version) and a signed DPA for the Salesforce partner onboarding flow. Please note: the SOC2 contains vendor names redacted per our contract with the assessor; if Salesforce needs full evidence we can arrange a controlled NDA transfer or view-only in our secure portal.

I’ve included a short summary of scope below:
- Assessment window: Feb 2025 — Apr 2025
- External + internal network, API auth flows, cloud misconfigurations
- No critical findings; two medium findings remediated (verified)

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the attestation.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@salesforce.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence index and asset list for Salesforce co-sell

Hi all —

Attached is the evidence-index.csv (attached) — quick columns: document_name, type, date_issued, owner_contact, access_instructions. Highlights:
- SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2024.pdf, SOC2, 2024-12-18, compliance@redwood.com, redacted PDF attached
- PenTest_Attestation_2025.pdf, Attestation, 2025-05-06, sergio@redwood.com, attestation attached; full report view-by-request
- DPA_Signed_Salesforce.pdf, DPA, 2026-08-24, laura@redwood.com, attached (executed)

If procurement or security at Salesforce wants a stricter transfer method, we can generate a temporary access ticket to our secure portal and enable view-only for specific documents.

Marcus Lin
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@salesforce.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@acme-retail.com>, salesforce-procurement@salesforce.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood co-sell listing — security evidence request

Thanks Vanessa / Sergio / Marcus — this is exactly what we needed. Procurement confirms the DPA matches our standard, and security is satisfied with the attestation + redacted SOC2 for now. Two quick asks before we close the packaging: 1) can you add a single-line contact phone for the attestation signer in the index, and 2) please include the DocuSign audit link for the executed DPA (we need signature timestamps).

If you can push those by EOD Thursday (Aug 27) we’ll move the listing to final review and schedule the co-sell kickoff.

Best,
Aisha
Partner Security Program Manager | Salesforce
